PARALEL Top(a AS I32, b AS I32) AS I32
    RETURN a + b

THREAD Fib(n AS I32) AS I32
    IF n < 2 THEN RETURN n
    DIM a AS TASK OF I32 = SPAWN Fib(n - 1)
    DIM b AS TASK OF I32 = SPAWN Fib(n - 2)
    RETURN a.JOIN() + b.JOIN()
END THREAD
DIM t AS TASK OF I32 = SPAWN Fib(10)
PRINT t.JOIN()
